lines: Most portfolios are built for the market you remember.
Northwind builds for the one that's coming.
Two point four billion under management. Fourteen years. One rule: no surprises.
Every position, every fee, every risk. On one screen, in plain English.
Twelve percent average annual return since twenty twelve. Eight straight years ahead of the index.
You don't get a quarterly letter. You get a live view.
Independent. Fee only. Fiduciary, in writing.
Northwind Capital. Built for what's next.
